entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • TypeConverter.GetConvertFromException and TypeConverter.GetConvertToException methods should not throw #122790
  • Task.Delay hangs indefinitely on Linux ARM32 when system clock is set backwards (.NET 10 regression) #122788
  • 'Unsafe.Unbox' works differently from the document #122782

Closed

  • [wasm] Better communication between apphost and browser #75335
    Future
  • [browser] move console proxy from runtime code into test-main #101169
    11.0.0
  • AWS Lambda times out because endless HttpMessageHandler cleanup #47672
  • BLAZORSDK1001 error BLAZORSDK1001: Unable to find '<lib>.wasm' to be lazy loaded later #120931
    Future
  • Clean up src/coreclr/src/inc : remove private implementation details #35624

PullRequests

Created

  • Cleanup __builtin_available where platform is now guaranteed on Apple platforms #122789
    os-ios, needs-area-label
  • [release/8.0][mono] Fix memory leak #122787
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Fix some memory leaks in mono #122784
    area-VM-meta-mono, community-contribution
  • Consolidate classlibnative directory into vm #122780

Merged

  • [browser][coreCLR] running main/exit/abort/logging and infra for unit testing #122646
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Fix file descriptor leak #122769
    area-System.Security, community-contribution
  • Move stgpool to md subsystem, extract memory streams, eliminate VM dependencies on MD internals #122723
    area-VM-coreclr
  • [LoongArch64] Align PR#108419: Verify TLS resolver code for LA64. #122767
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-loongarch64

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Fix UInt128 to double conversion for values >= 2^104 #122686
    Servicing-consider, area-System.Numerics, 10.0.x
  • Fix #84344 to ensure sufficient stack by calling RuntimeHelpers.EnsureSufficientExecutionStack() #122761
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • Add packed SearchValues<string> specialization for two strings #122749
    area-System.Runtime
  • [browser][coreCLR] kitchen sink #121412
    NO-REVIEW, arch-wasm, linkable-framework, area-System.Runtime.InteropServices.JavaScript, os-browser, 10.0.x
  • missing opportunities in constant folding around bitwise ops #99136
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • Intrinsify Enum.Equals to avoid boxing #122779
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [RuntimeAsync] Enable runtime async in Libraries partition #119432
    area-VM-coreclr, linkable-framework, runtime-async
